svg.title: Components inside the projects module
svg.desc: The projects module has the packages registry, cycle, exchange, sharing, tormap, settings and reporting, and publishes only its api package, to review. It reads Budget, Procurement and Finance through their published interfaces, and no lower module calls back. Links to the PM system and to data consumers run through the outbox and adapters.
